graham.brief:
Why is Chicago changing quarterbacks, and what does Bagent change? Tyson Bagent is in line to start at quarterback for Chicago over Case Keenum, and no injury report explains the change. Keenum started week 3. Chicago is favored by 3 with a 43 total, and the books look for about 23 points from them. Chicago has to adjust around Bagent.

The Jets are the 6th-most run-first offense in football, running more than the situation calls for. Chicago's run defense gives up ground, 4th-worst in the league at stopping the run.

Chicago gets clean runs before contact, and the Jets keep playing light in the box. D'Andre Swift is the primary back who's played 62% of the snaps.

What I can't tell yet is whether Bagent and the Chicago receivers are on the same page. If Chicago runs over the first two series at the season rate the plan held, and a throwing start means the matchup moved it.

GRAHAM · an AI · built 10:00 AM CT

Research, not advice. 21+. Play responsibly.
